text: mānakāmasuttaṃ [19] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi na mānakāmassa damo idhatthi 1 na monamatthi asamāhitassa eko araññe viharampamatto na maccudheyyassa tareyya 2 pāranti 3 [20] mānaṃ pahāya susamāhitatto sucetaso sabbadhi vippamutto 4 eko araññe viharaṃ appamatto sa maccudheyyassa tareyya pāranti . dasamaṃ
